```{r}
################################################################################
# BIVARIATE MORAN'S I ANALYSIS
# Testing Spatial Relationship Between Poverty and Pharmacy Distribution
# Hadeer Eid - NYC Pharmacy Equity Study
################################################################################
```


```{r}
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(tidyverse)

cat("\n")
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n")
# Bivariate spatial correlation: poverty vs pharmacy distribution
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n\n")
```


```{r}
# Assuming you have pharmacy_sf loaded with:
# - poverty_pct (continuous poverty rate)
# - is_chain (0/1 for chain vs non-chain)
# - pharmacy_count (or similar for total pharmacy density)
```


```{r}
# Check your data
cat("Data Summary:\n")
cat("Total observations:", nrow(pharmacy_sf), "\n")
cat("Missing poverty_pct:", sum(is.na(pharmacy_sf$poverty_pct)), "\n")
cat("Missing is_chain:", sum(is.na(pharmacy_sf$is_chain)), "\n\n")

# Filter complete cases
pharmacy_complete <- pharmacy_sf %>%
  filter(!is.na(poverty_pct) & !is.na(is_chain))

cat("Complete cases for analysis:", nrow(pharmacy_complete), "\n\n")

# Create spatial weights (k-nearest neighbors, k=8)
coords <- st_coordinates(pharmacy_complete)
knn_nb <- knn2nb(knearneigh(coords, k = 8))
knn_weights <- nb2listw(knn_nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)
```


```{r}
################################################################################
# TEST 1: POVERTY vs CHAIN PHARMACY PRESENCE
################################################################################

cat("\n")
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n")
# Test 1: Poverty vs chain pharmacy presence
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n\n")

cat("Research Question: Are high-poverty areas surrounded by low chain pharmacy presence?\n\n")

# Lee's L statistic (bivariate spatial correlation)
# This tests if poverty in location i is correlated with chain presence in neighboring locations j
lee_chain <- lee.test(
  x = pharmacy_complete$poverty_pct,
  y = pharmacy_complete$is_chain,
  listw = knn_weights,
  zero.policy = TRUE,
  alternative = "two.sided"
)

cat("Lee's L Bivariate Spatial Correlation Test:\n")
cat("------------------------------------------\n")
print(lee_chain)
cat("\n")

# Extract key statistics
lee_stat_chain <- lee_chain$estimate[1]
lee_pval_chain <- lee_chain$p.value

cat("KEY FINDINGS:\n")
cat("  Lee's L statistic:", round(lee_stat_chain, 4), "\n")
cat("  P-value:", format.pval(lee_pval_chain, digits = 3), "\n\n")

cat("INTERPRETATION:\n")
if (lee_pval_chain < 0.05) {
  if (lee_stat_chain < 0) {
    cat("  ✓ SIGNIFICANT NEGATIVE CORRELATION (p < .05)\n")
    cat("    → High-poverty areas are surrounded by LOW chain pharmacy presence\n")
    cat("    → Low-poverty areas are surrounded by HIGH chain pharmacy presence\n")
    cat("    → This confirms systematic spatial mismatch between poverty and chain access\n")
  } else {
    cat("  ✓ SIGNIFICANT POSITIVE CORRELATION (p < .05)\n")
    cat("    → High-poverty areas are surrounded by HIGH chain pharmacy presence\n")
    cat("    → This would suggest chains serve high-need areas\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("  ✗ NOT SIGNIFICANT (p ≥ .05)\n")
  cat("    → No significant spatial relationship detected\n")
}
cat("\n")
```


```{r}
################################################################################
# TEST 2: POVERTY vs TOTAL PHARMACY DENSITY
################################################################################

cat("\n")
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n")
# Test 2: Poverty vs total pharmacy density
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n\n")

# Calculate pharmacy density per census tract
# If you have census tract data aggregated:
# For now, using binary indicator - you may need to aggregate by tract first

# Alternative approach: count pharmacies per census tract
# This assumes you have a census_tract_id variable
if ("census_tract_id" %in% names(pharmacy_complete)) {
  
  cat("Calculating pharmacy density by census tract...\n")
  
  # Aggregate to census tract level
  tract_data <- pharmacy_complete %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(census_tract_id) %>%
    summarise(
      pharmacy_count = n(),
      mean_poverty = mean(poverty_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Get tract geometry (assuming first occurrence is representative)
  tract_sf <- pharmacy_complete %>%
    group_by(census_tract_id) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(census_tract_id) %>%
    left_join(tract_data, by = "census_tract_id")
  
  # Create spatial weights for tracts
  tract_coords <- st_coordinates(st_centroid(tract_sf))
  tract_knn_nb <- knn2nb(knearneigh(tract_coords, k = 8))
  tract_knn_weights <- nb2listw(tract_knn_nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)
  
  cat("Census tracts:", nrow(tract_sf), "\n\n")
  
  # Lee's L for total pharmacy density
  lee_total <- lee.test(
    x = tract_sf$mean_poverty,
    y = tract_sf$pharmacy_count,
    listw = tract_knn_weights,
    zero.policy = TRUE,
    alternative = "two.sided"
  )
  
  cat("Lee's L Bivariate Spatial Correlation Test:\n")
  cat("------------------------------------------\n")
  print(lee_total)
  cat("\n")
  
  # Extract key statistics
  lee_stat_total <- lee_total$estimate[1]
  lee_pval_total <- lee_total$p.value
  
  cat("KEY FINDINGS:\n")
  cat("  Lee's L statistic:", round(lee_stat_total, 4), "\n")
  cat("  P-value:", format.pval(lee_pval_total, digits = 3), "\n\n")
  
  cat("INTERPRETATION:\n")
  if (lee_pval_total < 0.05) {
    if (lee_stat_total < 0) {
      cat("  ✓ SIGNIFICANT NEGATIVE CORRELATION (p < .05)\n")
      cat("    → High-poverty areas have LOW total pharmacy density\n")
      cat("    → Low-poverty areas have HIGH total pharmacy density\n")
      cat("    → Pharmacy deserts exist in high-poverty neighborhoods\n")
    } else {
      cat("  ✓ SIGNIFICANT POSITIVE CORRELATION (p < .05)\n")
      cat("    → High-poverty areas have HIGH total pharmacy density\n")
      cat("    → This suggests overall pharmacy access is better in high-need areas\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("  ✗ NOT SIGNIFICANT (p ≥ .05)\n")
    cat("    → No significant spatial relationship detected\n")
  }
  cat("\n")
  
} else {
  cat("Note: Census tract aggregation requires 'census_tract_id' variable.\n")
  cat("Running alternative analysis using pharmacy-level data...\n\n")
  
  # Alternative: Use binary indicator for pharmacy presence
  # Create a variable indicating pharmacy density in neighborhood
  # This is less ideal but works with current data structure
  
  # For each pharmacy, calculate number of pharmacies within certain distance
  pharmacy_complete$pharmacy_density <- lengths(knn_nb)
  
  lee_total_alt <- lee.test(
    x = pharmacy_complete$poverty_pct,
    y = pharmacy_complete$pharmacy_density,
    listw = knn_weights,
    zero.policy = TRUE,
    alternative = "two.sided"
  )
  
  cat("Lee's L Test (using local pharmacy density):\n")
  cat("------------------------------------------\n")
  print(lee_total_alt)
  cat("\n")
  
  lee_stat_total <- lee_total_alt$estimate[1]
  lee_pval_total <- lee_total_alt$p.value
  
  cat("KEY FINDINGS:\n")
  cat("  Lee's L statistic:", round(lee_stat_total, 4), "\n")
  cat("  P-value:", format.pval(lee_pval_total, digits = 3), "\n\n")
  
  cat("Note: This tests local clustering intensity, not census tract-level density.\n\n")
}
```


```{r}
################################################################################
# COMPARISON SUMMARY
################################################################################

cat("\n")
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n")
# Summary
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n\n")

cat("Test 1 (Poverty vs Chain Pharmacies):\n")
cat("  Lee's L =", round(lee_stat_chain, 4), ", p =", format.pval(lee_pval_chain, digits = 3), "\n")
if (lee_pval_chain < 0.05 & lee_stat_chain < 0) {
  cat("  → Chain pharmacies avoid high-poverty areas (CONFIRMED)\n")
}

cat("\nTest 2 (Poverty vs Total Pharmacy Density):\n")
cat("  Lee's L =", round(lee_stat_total, 4), ", p =", format.pval(lee_pval_total, digits = 3), "\n")
if (lee_pval_total < 0.05 & lee_stat_total < 0) {
  cat("  → Overall pharmacy access is lower in high-poverty areas\n")
} else if (lee_pval_total < 0.05 & lee_stat_total > 0) {
  cat("  → Overall pharmacy access is higher in high-poverty areas\n")
  cat("  → Independent pharmacies may be compensating for chain absence\n")
}

cat("\n")
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n")
# Done
cat("=" %>% rep(80) %>% paste(collapse = ""), "\n")
```


```{r}
################################################################################
# OPTIONAL: VISUALIZATION
################################################################################

cat("\nCreating bivariate Moran scatterplot...\n")

# Moran scatterplot for poverty vs chain pharmacies
png("outputs/bivariate_moran_scatterplot.png", 
    width = 10, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

# Plot 1: Poverty vs Spatially Lagged Chain Presence
lag_chain <- lag.listw(knn_weights, pharmacy_complete$is_chain)
plot(pharmacy_complete$poverty_pct, lag_chain,
     xlab = "Poverty Rate (%)",
     ylab = "Spatially Lagged Chain Pharmacy Presence",
     main = "Bivariate Moran: Poverty vs Chain Pharmacies",
     pch = 19, col = alpha("blue", 0.3))
abline(lm(lag_chain ~ pharmacy_complete$poverty_pct), col = "red", lwd = 2)
abline(h = mean(lag_chain), v = mean(pharmacy_complete$poverty_pct), 
       lty = 2, col = "gray")
text(max(pharmacy_complete$poverty_pct)*0.8, max(lag_chain)*0.9,
     paste0("Lee's L = ", round(lee_stat_chain, 3), "\np = ", 
            format.pval(lee_pval_chain, digits = 2)),
     cex = 1.2, font = 2)

# Plot 2: If using tract data
if (exists("tract_sf")) {
  lag_total <- lag.listw(tract_knn_weights, tract_sf$pharmacy_count)
  plot(tract_sf$mean_poverty, lag_total,
       xlab = "Mean Poverty Rate (%)",
       ylab = "Spatially Lagged Total Pharmacies",
       main = "Bivariate Moran: Poverty vs Total Pharmacy Density",
       pch = 19, col = alpha("darkgreen", 0.3))
  abline(lm(lag_total ~ tract_sf$mean_poverty), col = "red", lwd = 2)
  abline(h = mean(lag_total), v = mean(tract_sf$mean_poverty), 
         lty = 2, col = "gray")
  text(max(tract_sf$mean_poverty)*0.8, max(lag_total)*0.9,
       paste0("Lee's L = ", round(lee_stat_total, 3), "\np = ", 
              format.pval(lee_pval_total, digits = 2)),
       cex = 1.2, font = 2)
}

dev.off()

cat("Scatterplot saved to: outputs/bivariate_moran_scatterplot.png\n")
```
